items.body:
MAINTENANCE
Jul 9, 2026
V.269 KNOWN ISSUES

The Known Issues section focuses on the major issues that have significantly impacted the game and community, and which our team is actively addressing. Please note that while we aim to cover the most impactful issues, this list will not encompass every reported issue. Check back regularly for updates on the status of these issues and information on resolved issues, or any new issues that may have been added.

Here you’ll find a list of known and resolved issues from the v.269 - Ride the Lightning update:

KNOWN ISSUES

Weapons and secondary weapons for Erel Light characters become unlocked when switching equipment presets.
This issue will be resolved during the scheduled maintenance on July 22.
Vestige of Erion Coupons are unintentionally dropping upon defeating weekly bosses.
Players who obtained Vestige of Erion Coupons during this period will be able to use them after the v270 patch.
The 21st Anniversary Maple University Event Buff ended earlier than scheduled.
We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience to your gameplay. As a token of our apology, we will be distributing the following rewards to all players:
VIP Booster (x10)
4x EXP Coupon (x10)
Nodestone (x300)
Experience Nodestone (x20)
VIP Sauna Pass (x4)
Rewards will be distributed via Gift Drop and will be tradable within world, 14-day duration.
Erel Light characters are unable to proceed with the "[Erel Light] The New Head Captain" quest after completing the 6th Job Advancement, preventing them from obtaining the "Echo of Hero" skill.
This issue will be resolved during the next scheduled maintenance.
RESOLVED ISSUES
June 26, 2026
Resolved an issue where the Accessory Miracle Time event was limited to Bonus Potential Cubes only.
The Potential feature has been re-enabled, and a rescheduled date for the Accessories Miracle Time event will be announced at a later time.
Resolved an issue where the Challenger World weekly hunting mission count would incorrectly reset after midnight.
June 25, 2026
Resolved an issue where certain Erel Light Skill Nodes were not working as intended.
Resolved an issue where Wren's description in the World Archive was incorrect.
Resolved an issue where the image icon for the Event Ring Exclusive Solid Cube received from the Hyper Burning MAX event on Interactive Challenger Worlds was incorrect.
Resolved an issue where the text description for Magnificent Kai Soul was incorrect.
Resolved an issue where the event period for the SHINE Pass was incorrect.
Resolved an issue where the 'Date Obtained' description for Intense Power Crystals was formatted incorrectly.
Resolved an issue where the Gram of Holy Light weapon would appear in front of characters when climbing.
Resolved an issue where the skill description of Guild Skills was incorrect.
Resolved an issue where the icon image for the Witness to the Beyond Medal was displayed incorrectly.
Resolved an issue where the description for the Magnificent Commander's Soul Box was incorrect.
Resolved an issue where the event period for the Arthur's Equipment Rental event was displayed incorrectly.
Resolved an issue where the pop-up description when purchasing certain items from the Phantasmal Echoes Record Hall Shop was incorrect.
Resolved an issue where using the Phantasmal Tree furnishing item in your Home would sometimes cause a crash.
Resolved an issue where the 'Skip' button was placed incorrectly during cutscenes in the Merged Dimensions quest.
Resolved an issue where the Theme Change feature was not functioning correctly on the Character Selection screen.
Resolved an issue where using a Unique Potential Gentle Summer Researcher Familiar would cause a crash when attacking bosses.
Resolved an issue where the Mysterious Green Pouch from Mystic Familiar Expedition would sometimes fail to grant a Karma Bright Cube reward, causing the reward to be treated as no item was obtained.
Resolved an issue where the '[Daily Quest] Peace in Arcana' was unable to be completed using the 'Complete All' button on the Maple Planner.
Resolved an issue where Sia Astelle characters would crash after accepting the '[Aftermath] After That Day' quest.
Resolved an issue where the ‘[Weekly Quest] Erda’s Request’ quest did not properly reset for some accounts.
Resolved an issue where opening the Weapon Jump Ring from Ring Boxes may provide a ring with the incorrect stat for the character on Challenger - Heroic Worlds.
Resolved an issue where the text description provided from Spiegelette after using the Spiegelette's GTPK One-Time Entry Pass was incorrect.
Resolved an issue where resetting the Wild Hunter Job Nodes requires them to be unlocked again instead of starting at Lv. 1.
Resolved an issue in Interactive Worlds where Cash items would become untradeable after being traded.
Resolved an issue where Sia Astelle and Erel Light characters were unable to proceed with the Job Advancement quests via the Maple Guide.
Resolved an issue where the weekly reset for Item Burning PLUS was earlier than intended.
Resolved an issue where Erel Light characters were unable to complete parts of the Black Heaven questline.
Resolved an issue where, under certain circumstances, attempting to purchase the Fashion Pass displayed an incorrect required amount of Maple Points, showing 2k instead of the correct 20k.
Resolved an issue where the Erel Light Outfit Selector Coupon listed "Researcher's Starlight Outfit Set" twice instead of "Seeker's Outfit Set". The text is now corrected to display both outfit sets properly.
Resolved an issue where activating the Challengers Pass required entering a character name to designate a character. The text is updated to require the World name instead.
Resolved an issue where the Level 230 Shine Box could not be opened if the player already had Abyss Hunter Ring.
Resolved an issue where Erel Light and Sia Astelle characters were not granted the Return to OOO skill upon character creation.
Resolved an issue where the Furnishing Slot Expansion Coupon was not functioning properly.
Resolved an issue where the event period displayed incorrectly in Challenger Partner when declining to claim mission rewards.
items.bodyZh:
维护公告  
2026年6月17日  
V.269 已知问题  

已知问题部分聚焦于已对游戏和社区产生重大影响、且我们团队正在积极处理的主要问题。请注意，虽然我们力求涵盖最具影响力的问题，但此列表不会包含所有已报告的问题。请定期查看以获取这些问题的最新状态、已解决问题信息或新增问题。  

以下为v.269 - 电光石火更新中已知及已解决的问题列表：  

已解决问题  
- 修复了“[每周任务] 艾尔达的请求”任务未重置的问题。该任务将于周五 UTC 时间凌晨12:00重置。  
- 修复了在某些情况下，尝试购买时尚通行证时显示错误的所需枫叶点数（显示为2k而非正确的20k）的问题。  
- 修复了埃雷尔·光之服装选择券将“研究员星光服装套装”列出两次而非“追寻者服装套装”的问题。文本现已修正，正确显示两套服装套装。  
- 修复了激活挑战者通行证需输入角色名以指定角色的问题。文本已更新为要求输入世界名称。  
- 修复了玩家已拥有深渊猎手戒指时，无法打开230级闪耀箱的问题。  
- 修复了埃雷尔·光与希亚·阿斯特尔角色在创建时未获得“返回OOO”技能的问题。  
- 修复了家具槽扩展券无法正常使用的问题。  
- 修复了在挑战者伙伴中拒绝领取任务奖励时，活动期间显示错误的问题。

items.title: maintenanceJul 7, 2026[Completed]Scheduled Minor Patch Maintenance - July 9, 2026The maintenance has been completed and we have extended Cash Shop items in your inventory for 5 hours.
items.body:
MAINTENANCE
Jul 7, 2026
[COMPLETED]SCHEDULED MINOR PATCH MAINTENANCE - JULY 9, 2026

[Updated 7/9 at 11:55 AM PDT] The maintenance has been completed and we have extended Cash Shop items in your inventory for 5 hours. Please restart your Nexon Launcher or Steam to ensure you receive the latest client update.

We will be performing a scheduled minor patch maintenance starting on Thursday, July 9, 2026 at 7:00 AM PDT (10:00 AM EDT / 4:00 PM CEST / 12:00 AM AEST July 10). We anticipate the maintenance to last approximately 5 hours, concluding around 12:00 PM PDT (3:00 PM EDT / 9:00 PM CEST / 5:00 AM AEST July 10).

Times:

Thursday, July 9, 2026
PDT (UTC -7): 7:00 AM - 12:00 PM
EDT (UTC -4): 10:00 AM - 3:00 PM
CEST (UTC +2): 4:00 PM - 9:00 PM
AEST (UTC +10): 12:00 AM July 10 - 5:00 AM July 10

What will be unavailable:

All MapleStory game servers.

Changes and Updates:

MapleStory will be updated to v.269.3.0.
Resolved an issue where missing an attack while using the Receipt Damage Skin (Unit) would sometimes cause the client to crash.
Resolved an issue where Lynn's Whirlwind skill in the corner would sometimes cause the client to freeze.
Resolved an issue where the Beyond Burning event was only accessible through the Character Selection screen.
Resolved an issue where the Beyond Burning event would incorrectly display the claimable reward icon despite having no rewards to claim from the event.
Resolved an issue where the NPC Isaac would appear multiple times during Sia Astelle's story questline.
Resolved an issue where Malefic Star would incorrectly drop certain items.
Resolved an issue where the Arcane Umbra Gram and AbsoLab Gram weapons were unable to be enhanced with certain scrolls.
Resolved an issue where the text for the base meso cost would not change when utilizing the Enhancement Mode Slider during the Shining Star Force event.
Resolved an issue where Breath of the Artisan was dropping incorrectly.
Resolved an issue where the Nightmare Paradise Epic Dungeon was unable to be started if you completed the High Mountain and Angler Company Epic Dungeons first.
Resolved an issue in the Operation: Drive event where Erel Light characters would sometimes be disconnected when attacking as Althea.
Resolved an issue where Spiegelette's dialogue was incorrect in the Golden Tomato Punch King Entrance.

MAINTENANCE
Jun 26, 2026
[COMPLETED] UNSCHEDULED CHANNEL MAINTENANCE - JUNE 26, 2026

[Updated 6:16 PM PDT] The channel maintenance has been completed. Thank you for your patience.

Updates:

Resolved an issue where the Challenger World weekly hunting mission count would incorrectly reset after midnight.
Resolved an issue where the Accessory Miracle Time event was limited to Bonus Potential Cubes only.
The Potential feature has been re-enabled, and a rescheduled date for the Accessories Miracle Time event will be announced at a later time.

[Updated 4:10 PM PDT] Channel maintenance schedule has been updated. Please refer to the new schedule below. 

[Updated 3:15 PM PDT] We are currently testing the fixes planned for the unscheduled channel maintenance and will need additional time to complete testing. We will be adjusting the maintenance time and will provide an update as soon as possible. Thank you for your patience and we apologize for the inconvenience.

We will be performing a channel maintenance today, June 26, 2026 at 4:30 PM PDT (7:30 PM EDT / 1:30 AM CEST June 27 / 9:30 AM AEST June 27). We anticipate the maintenance to last approximately 2.5 hours, concluding around 7:00 PM June 26 PDT (10:00 PM EDT June 26/ 4:00 AM CEST June 27/ 12:00 PM AEST June 27).

PDT (UTC -7): 4:30 PM - 7:00 PM
